payload.message: • Full geometry study on Naca0015 sail: one fixed body, solved end to end. • Question: does the chain produce a converged force on a believable mesh? • No prior: mesh quality and convergence are the only evidence.
• Fails if: surface won't mesh; gates exceeded (non-ortho 70°, skew 4); or the force never settles.
• The gates are the standard acceptance band, per OpenFOAM mesh-quality guidance. • The mesh is judged against a published threshold, not itself.

payload.message: • Surface measured: 20,924 triangles, streamwise X, span Z. • Working scale: 1.2 m long, 1.8 m across.
• Scale basis: the file's units are dimensionally plausible, so I am taking them as metres. • The Reynolds number and every force ride on this length, so it goes on the record.
• Case built: farfield from the body's own bounding box, k-omega SST. • Reference area: measured planform 2.16 m². • Freestream 75 m/s; Re 6.0e+06.
• Reference area must be measured from the body itself. • Same discipline as our NACA 4412 validation: measure first, then compare.
• Surface accepted: Naca0015 sail, closed. • No defects reported by the surface check.
• Selected: k-omega SST, steady RANS, standard closure for attached external flow, solved on a quality-gated mesh.

payload.message: Conclusion
• From raw surface to a converged force in 14.7 minutes, no hand tuning at any step. • The coefficient history is flat across the averaging window, so the quoted band is meaningful.
• No published comparison for this body; the number stands on mesh quality, convergence, and the grid study.
• Mesh sensitivity measured on three meshes of this case; the band rides the numerical channel of the certificate. • Total spend 14 core-minutes, refinement rungs included.

payload.title: Geometry study: Naca0015 sail
abstract: We took Naca0015 sail through surface check, meshing, and a steady solve to establish whether the chain yields a trustworthy force.
The mesh reached 243,929 cells at max non-orthogonality 47.1° and max skewness 2.65; drag settled at 0.01015 ± 4e-06.
The result is reported as solver-backed: a selected-solver result; envelope 0.0% of value.
methods: Surface intake and check on Naca0015 sail.
Background mesh plus snappyHexMesh to 243,929 cells; quality gated at 70° non-orthogonality and 4 skewness.
Potential-flow initialisation followed by 300 steady iterations.
Forces averaged over the final fifth of the iteration history; the band is the spread of that window.
